column5: Ah,　there　you　are。 / Your　dedicated　work　in　my　LAB / has　been　much　appreciated。 / And　now,　your　fieldwork / assignment　is　about　to　begin。
As　you　know,　at　the　heart　of / my　research　is　the　relationship / between　POKひMON　and　people。。。
。。。How　they　grow　together / through　trust,　battle, / friendship。。。 / Even　evolution　may　be　shaped / by　those　bonds。

But　to　understand　this,　you / need　to　go　where　they　live。 / The　towns,　forests,　caves, / shorelines,　and　old　ruins。 / I　am　too　old　for　fieldwork　now, / but　you　are　just　the　right　age / for　this　expedition。
Now　tell　me　for　your / FIELD　AIDE　record。
Are　you　a　boy　or　a　girl？
And　how　do　you　spell / your　name？
And how do you spell / your name?
Right… / RED.
This is my grandson. / Like you, he has been helping / with my research here in / PALLET TOWN. / His name is...
His name is BLUE?
Yes. / His name is BLUE. /
RED! / KANTO is waiting beyond the LAB. / Observe carefully, learn directly, / and trust the POKéMON at your side. / Your fieldwork begins now.
RED played with the NES. / …Okay! / It’s time to go!
OAK: Wait! / Don’t leave yet!
OAK: It’s unsafe! / POKéMON live in tall grass. / You need your own POKéMON for / your protection. / Come with me.
BLUE: Gramps! / I’m fed up with waiting!
OAK: Ah, BLUE! / Good, you’re both here. / You have both helped in this LAB / for some time. / This summer, I need you as / field aides. / It is time you studied KANTO / directly, beyond the LAB.
BLUE: If we’re doing fieldwork, / then we need POKéMON.

OAK: Exactly, BLUE. / Fieldwork cannot be done safely / without partners of your own. / These 3 were recently sent / to me by another researcher in ALOLA. / My cousin SAMSON OAK. / They’re young, but they’re / bright, adaptable, and well suited / for fieldwork. / Choose carefully.
Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice. / You should raise it patiently. / So, RED, you’re claiming the / FIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?
This POKéMON is really quite / energetic!
RED received the CHARMANDER / from PROF. OAK!
Do you want to give a nickname to / this CHARMANDER?
BLUE: I’ll take this one, then!
BLUE received the SQUIRTLE / from PROF. OAK!
BLUE: Wait, RED! / Let’s check out our POKéMON! / Come on, I’ll take you on!
WHAT? / Unbelievable! / I picked the wrong POKéMON!
OAK: That’s enough.
OAK: Both of you, over here. / There’s something important / you need to hear before / you begin.
OAK: I have a request for you two.
On the desk here is my / invention, the POKéDEX! / It records the POKéMON you see / and catch. / It’ll help us understand how / they live across KANTO.
OAK: RED and BLUE. / Take these with you. / Record what you find and / come back wiser.
RED received the POKéDEX / from PROF. OAK.
OAK: Seeing POKéMON is useful, / but catching them teaches you more. / Travel with them. / Battle with them. / That is how real understanding / begins. / Take these POKé BALLS with you.
RED received five POKé BALLS!
RED put the POKé BALLS / in the POKé BALLS.
OAK: Furthermore, pay attention / to how the GYM LEADERS in / KANTO treat their POKéMON. / They know more than strength / alone. / There is much to learn from them.
BLUE: Heh. Fine by me. / I’ll be finished learning / everything worth knowing before / you’ve even caught up. / Try not to fall too far behind.
OAK: We’ll see. / Power and understanding / rarely arrive at the same time. / Off you go, then. / Your expedition begins now.
My father once told me he / ventured deep into VIRIDIAN / FOREST. / He heard the grumbling growls of / a shadowy figure lurking within.
Rumour recorded.

BLUE: Ha! Hey, RED. / Bet you’re heading to PEWTER! / Still thinking like a tourist, / huh? / Everyone acts like KANTO is / one straight road. / There are better leads through / DIGLETT’S CAVE, VIRIDIAN / CHANNEL, and the ferry south / of PALLET. / So, go on. / Pick the obvious road if you want. / I’ll be doing actual fieldwork.
I’m too scared to enter / VIRIDIAN FOREST. / Legends tell of the forest / coming alive and ensnaring the / wicked, never to be seen again.
Rumour updated.
CUBONE: Kyoo!
Rumour recorded.
VIRIDIAN FOREST
The flowers in VIRIDIAN FOREST / are so beautiful. / They seem more vibrant and grow / in number the closer you get to / the centre of the forest. / Almost like something is drawing / them inward.
Rumour updated.
GREEEAOW!
TANGROWTH vanished into the / flowers!
LANCE: This is where / I lost sight of them. / GIOVANNI’s signal was / breaking. / MEWTWO was beginning to / choose for itself.
GIOVANNI: The signal / still holds. / MEWTWO, return to me.
MEWTWO: GYAAOOO! / LANCE: It’s rejecting / his control!
GIOVANNI: MEWTWO! / You will not escape me. / Not again!
LANCE: It fled north. / GIOVANNI followed it toward / CERULEAN CAVE.

GIOVANNI: So this is the answer. / I poured wealth, science, and will / into creating absolute power. / Yet when it stood before me, no / order I gave could bind it. / Not force. Not fear. / Not even the strongest BALLS. / It has judged me unworthy. / Perhaps you will fare better. / Go on, then. / Show me what power answers to / when it refuses to answer to me.

OAK: The POKéDEX is struggling / to classify that presence. / MEWTWO’s power is not natural / instinct alone. / It is a question we created / but do not understand.

GIOVANNI: So that is the difference. / I tried to possess MEWTWO. / You faced it as a TRAINER. / Perhaps absolute power was never / something a person could own. / There is nothing left for me / to take from this place.
